dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "You know, if there's no work for engineers here, maybe we should try our luck at Yilong Wharf? I seem to recall they once imported a cargo of clockwork meka..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Ha. You think you're the only one to think of that? Miss Hautemontagne has been there for the last three months!"
